title: SaaS MRR, ARR, LTV & Net Churn Projection Calculator
meta_description: Model 12-month SaaS MRR growth, ARR, Net Dollar Retention (NDR), customer lifetime value (LTV), and compounding monthly revenue churn.
lead: Project 12-month recurring revenue compounding by balancing new monthly MRR, expansion upgrades, and gross revenue churn.
formula_html:
Monthly Recursion: MRR[t] = MRR[t-1] × (1 - Churn% + Expansion%) + New MRR.

Customer LTV: ARPU / Monthly Gross Churn Rate. Net Dollar Retention (12m): (1 - Churn% + Expansion%)12.

faqs.a: When expansion MRR from seat growth or tier upgrades exceeds gross churned revenue, your existing customer cohort grows automatically every month even without new signups.

faqs.q: Where does SaaS MRR plateau if churn stays constant?
faqs.a: When net retention is below 100%, MRR approaches a mathematical ceiling equal to New Monthly MRR divided by Net Monthly Churn Rate.
